answer: Each identity locks 24 POA for 19 epochs and posts an onyx commitment to its funding path. A juniper beacon picks 8 established auditors; 6 replay signed work receipts. Linked member k owes 24*k^2 POA, so the next fake adds 24*(2*k-1). The inlet ledger publishes links and samples; a failed replay burns all cluster bonds and blocks its keys for 15 epochs.
